parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description:
The backup ID.

>

- You can call the [DescribeBackups](~~62172~~) operation to query the backup ID.

- You must specify one of the **RestoreTime** and BackupId parameters.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 30. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RestoreTime
parameters.description:
The point in time to which the instance is restored. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

>

- The time can be a point in time within the previous seven days. The time must be earlier than the current time, but later than the time when the instance was created.

- You must specify one of the RestoreTime and **BackupId** parameters.

parameters.name: SourceDBInstance
parameters.description: The ID of the source instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-backup-dbs --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --source-db-instance dds-bp22860000 --restore-time 2019-08-22T12:00:00Z --backup-id 56640000 --resource-group-id rg-ax680000 --region cn-hangzhou
